text:
alex_sales: Heads up: ACME POC hitting 5xxs during demo. Started ~10:15 PT. Repro steps: 1) ~200 parallel chat requests with long context (~2048 tokens) 2) streaming enabled. Getting 502/503 from frontdoor. Need oncall.
infra-bot: Alert: 503 spike on prod-host-13 at 2026-03-21T10:15:22Z — incoming rate surge detected.
jamie_support: looking. can you paste a trace id or request id? also what's their region + model?
maria_acme: region us-west-2, model: llama-70b-8k-quant. Trace ids: t-8f3a, t-8f3b. We started ramp from 20->200 RPS in ~2 mins.
kevin_oncall: 👍 grabbing logs. quick check: are they running batch_size=1? batching settings matter. also check autoscale cooldown (default 120s).
jamie_support: got logs for t-8f3a. root cause looks like queue pressure -> router started returning 502 when node pool queue_wait_ms > 1500ms. snippet: `ERROR ServeQueue: queue_wait_ms=1720 backlog=62`.
alex_sales: Customer asks about temporary dedicated pool while we triage. Estimate cost?
jamie_support: Quick option: enable pre-warmed capacity (reserve 30 gpus) for demo window. Ballpark = $4k/day. Or bump autoscale min_nodes to 5 for demo (cheaper short term).
maria_acme: Can you confirm behavior if autoscale lags? Does request fallback to another region/model?
kevin_oncall: By default we route cross-region only if policy allows. Fallback to smaller model variant is available — `llama-70b-quant-lite` and `llama-13b-opt`. Also recommend client-side retries: 3 attempts with exponential backoff + jitter.
jamie_support: temporary workaround: reduce max_context to 1024, enable prefix KV cache, and use `X-Request-Priority: high` header. Example curl: `curl -H 'X-Request-Priority: high' -d '{"input":"...","max_tokens":512}' https://api.redwood/v1/generate`.
maria_acme: We can reduce to 1024 for demo. Also, how long to set min_nodes?
jamie_support: Set min_nodes to 4 and prewarm for 15 minutes. Autoscale cooldown is 120s, expect capacity to be stable in ~3-4 min after prewarm. I'll open a support ticket to apply changes.
alex_sales: Thanks. Also syncing on compliance Qs — they want SOC2 docs. I'll loop in AE.
kevin_oncall: Ticket created: #SUP-91234. I've applied temporary routing rule to avoid the busiest host. Monitor dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/teams/acme/poc/traffic
infra-bot: Deploybot: applied routing rule to route 15% traffic to us-east-1 as fallback.
jamie_support: Follow-ups: 1) we'll provide a postmortem with histograms for queue_wait_ms 2) pricing for dedicated short-term 3) checklist for prewarm + retry headers. I'll ping once done.
maria_acme: Appreciate it. Keeping demo at 11:00 PT — will confirm if we should proceed with reduced context.
alex_sales: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate.
